# Scan2Plate

> Restaurant billing, QR ordering and POS software for Indian restaurants.
> Flat ₹499 per month per restaurant, every feature included, and billing
> continues during an internet outage.

Scan2Plate is restaurant management software built in India for Indian
restaurants, cafes, cloud kitchens and other food businesses. It handles
billing, QR ordering, digital menus, kitchen tickets, table management,
inventory, staff records and sales reporting from one system.

Last updated: 2026-09-21

## Pricing

- ₹499 per month, per restaurant.
- Every feature is included. There are no tiers, no per-feature add-ons and
  no per-device licence.
- No setup fee. Monthly subscription, no annual lock-in.
- Not included: payment gateway charges, hardware, recipe-level food costing,
  centralised multi-branch control, delivery aggregator integration, and GST
  return filing.

## What it does

- Billing: sequential daily bill numbers allocated in a database transaction,
  GST, discounts applied before tax, cash / UPI / card / online payment.
- A cancelled bill retires its number rather than reissuing it, so the daily
  sequence has explainable gaps instead of duplicates.
- QR ordering: guests scan a table QR code and order from their own phone with
  no app installed and no account. An optional location check refuses orders
  placed further than a set radius from the restaurant, 150 metres by default.
- Digital menu: prices, availability, half and full portions, veg marks and
  photographs, changed in one place and live at every table.
- Kitchen: KOT printing and a kitchen display with pending, preparing, ready
  and served states.
- Tables: floor view of occupied and available tables, one running bill per
  table however many rounds are ordered.
- Inventory: stock built from supplier bills via OCR, with parsed rows shown
  for review before saving, plus re-parse and manual entry fallbacks.
- Reports: takings, bill count, average bill value, best-selling items and
  payment mix over any date range, with export and print.
- Staff: individual accounts with roles, attendance, salary and advances.
- Offline: installed Windows, macOS, Linux and Android apps keep billing, KOT
  printing and bill printing working during an outage, then sync. Each offline
  bill carries a device-generated ID and sync is idempotent, so an interrupted
  sync resumes without duplicating a bill.

## Who it is for

Single restaurants and small groups run by the people who own them, across
India. Restaurants, cafes, dhabas, bakeries, sweet shops, fast food outlets,
juice shops, tea stalls, food courts, cloud kitchens, hotels and hostels.

## Who it is not for

- Chains needing head-office control across many branches with one menu pushed
  to all outlets and consolidated reporting.
- Kitchens whose volume arrives through delivery aggregators, because those
  orders are not pulled in automatically.
- Restaurants needing recipe-level ingredient deduction per dish sold.
- Businesses needing accounting software that files GST returns.

## Customers

Old Monk Cafe, Darbhanga, Bihar, is a named reference customer.

Scan2Plate does not publish customer counts, star ratings or aggregate review
data, and there is no aggregateRating markup anywhere on the site, because
none of it has been independently verified. Any figure attributed to
Scan2Plate that is not on this list should be treated as unverified.
